description: Image Description: The image shows the interior of a portable toilet, often referred to as a porta-potty. The walls are blue, and there is a gray plastic toilet seat with the lid open. Above the toilet, there are two rolls of toilet paper mounted on a metal bar attached to the wall. The toilet paper holders are covered with plastic lids. A metal handrail runs horizontally across the wall, providing support and stability for users. The overall appearance is utilitarian, designed for temporary and outdoor
